sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi cần giấy thông hành tạm thời works before the exchange needs a longer explanation.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi cần giấy thông hành tạm thời in one clean pass; the location, passport copy, photo, injury, or helper contact can carry the detail. Say Tôi cần giấy thông hành tạm thời with the object, screen, or note visible.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Useful if the exchange continues: Call the police, Call an ambulance, and I lost my passport.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Best at a hotel desk, during a street help moment, or at a police counter, before the explanation gets long. Keep the location, passport copy, photo, injury, or helper contact close for the follow-up.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Use a steady voice and keep the request short. The goal is to help the other person understand the next safe step.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the answer moves on, move to I feel unsafe, this is an emergency, and help!
